Lloyd's Register approves new rules for nuclear for maritime
articles.원문 요약: UK-based classification society and professional advisory service Lloyd's Register has approved Rules for the Classification of Ships and Offshore Units Integrated with Nuclear Power, providing a common classification framework to support the assessment of nuclear technologies for maritime use.

articles.제목: Partners prepare to procure next batch of equipment for Polish plant
articles.원문 요약: Polskie Elektrownie Jądrowe has signed a letter of intent with the Westinghouse-Bechtel consortium concerning the extension of the scope of the Engineering Development Agreement to cover activities related to the procurement of long lead items for the initial unit of Poland's planned first nuclear power plant.

articles.제목: Pacific Fusion secures key licence for New Mexico campus
articles.원문 요약: The New Mexico Environment Department has approved the radioactive materials licence for pulsed magnetic fusion system developer Pacific Fusion's Research and Manufacturing Campus in Albuquerque, enabling the company to operate a fusion machine.

articles.제목: South Africa moving ahead on new nuclear plans
articles.원문 요약: Energy Minister Kgosientsho Ramokgopa has said his department is preparing to put the case for an additional 5.2 GW of nuclear capacity in South Africa "before the public and will consider submissions on their merits".

articles.제목: Radiant expands facilities to support microreactor deployment
articles.원문 요약: The multimillion-dollar expansion of Radiant's US manufacturing footprint includes a new headquarters and manufacturing facility in California, where its first commercial reactors will be assembled, as well as continued development of its campus in Tennessee.
